headline: RMAFC moves to reduce Nigeria’s reliance on oil revenue
summary: Nigeria's Revenue Mobilisation, Allocation and Fiscal Commission has begun preparing a national policy framework. It aims to expand government revenue sources, reduce dependence on oil earnings and strengthen fiscal sustainability across all three tiers of government.
why: Oil revenue is the main source of government income in Nigeria, so fiscal diversification affects sovereign credit, the naira and oil-sector investment.
